summary: The robot failed to complete the race, with zero progress and completion. It experienced a high number of line loss events (266), indicating frequent loss of track detection. Control effort is relatively high at 63.14, while maximum and RMS errors are low, suggesting precise but ineffective control. Noise robustness is good at 0.97, and steering oscillation is moderate. The geometry with a 0.22m body length and 0.16m wheel track may require adjustments to improve line tracking and reduce line loss events.
